content.text:
David Tepper’s Appaloosa Goes Big on SpaceX, While Slashing Alphabet Stake
After SpaceX stock swooned following its initial public offering in June, billionaire investor David Tepper’s Appaloosa hedge fund snapped up nearly 3.7 million new shares of it during the third quarter. Valued at $518 million, that acquisition was Appaloosa’s biggest move in a busy trading quarter for the firm, according to a new filing on Monday.
